name: cloudops-hub
description: Intelligent Cloud Operations Platform - Unified web platform for cloud engineering operations

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/config
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.db:push: npm run build:packages && npm run db:push --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run db:migrate --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:packages && npm run db:seed --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
